sourceFile: 28. BRS-161014 DT Report test VP mold #2,3,4,5,8,10  check the actual VP bending with the supplier    date 20.3.2024_clean.xlsx

aiVerification.summary: Draft has citeable data but materially misgroups separate reports and mismatches comparison keys.
issues: Combines two distinct sheet reports into one changed factor.
Changed factor overbroad: supplier/material/coating/jig not proven.
Baseline/test grouping mixes normal molds with unrelated test molds.
Subresults ignore date, line, and side/group keys.
Generated measurement stats appear spurious from headers/tables.
correctionPlan: Split sheet 5.3 and sheet 7.3 into separate review cases or factors.
For 5.3, define change as VP mold #7/#9 add 0.05mm vs normal molds.
Compare only within same date, line, and section, or use cited total rows.
For 7.3, treat molds #2/#3/#4/#5/#8/#10 as test mold candidates without normal baseline.
Remove unsupported domains and spurious measurement outcomes.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Row IDs exist, but citations are not sufficient until regrouped by report and row keys.
